pos.personaBrief: League possession dominance but in Europe a counter-oriented side that happily ceded the ball to Barcelona (Ballverliebt, Breaking The Lines); wins by danger over possession share.

pro.personaBrief: Neuer launched long balls when pressed and centre-backs played long (HSV, StatsBomb), with quick transitions after winning the ball, yet pivot players Schweinsteiger and Martinez kept it safe.

est.personaBrief: Defined 4-2-3-1 roles with a compact block and positional style (Spielverlagerung), but wide players, fullbacks and the ten rotated and moved diagonally; strikers stayed central.

lar.personaBrief: Ribery, Robben and attacking fullbacks Lahm and Alaba gave a clear wing-based advantage and width stretching the field (Ballverliebt, These Football Times, Get German Football News).

blo.personaBrief: Attackers were first defenders, a high compact block with halfway-line pressing and a high line, counter-pressing after losses; dropped deeper only in the first part of the final.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal position-orientated block with situational man orientation: Schweinsteiger on Xavi, Dante on Messi, centre-backs man-marking per Breaking The Lines.

pla.personaBrief: Heynckes tweaked tactics specifically against Barcelona and Dortmund, mixing league possession with European counter play, and adjusted at half-time in the final; adapts to the squad and opponent.

res.personaBrief: A winning, pragmatic treble side that played to win away at Barcelona-level opposition and said it was not a defensive team; results first but with attacking quality.

sis.personaBrief: Selfless stars who tracked back (Ribery, Robben), a well-drilled system with rotation and defined roles; organization cited as the decisive factor.

jog.personaBrief: Physical superiority in transitions and duels with Martinez, Dante, Boateng, plus technique in the wingers; hard physical effort praised by Heynckes; no classic idle ten.

bas.personaBrief: Squad of expensive signings (Martinez 40m) and veterans like Pizarro, with youth debuts only after the title was won.

lid.personaBrief: Experienced Heynckes managed egos, found the right approach per player and built a united group, yet stars followed the same work rules.
